blocks.text: Dohra:

Then did all the Brars calling an assembly of their whole fraternity, They decided upon a line of action (to deal with the Singhs). Resolving to disguise themselves in the guise of Gilja Pathans, They must launch an attack on the Khalsa Panth Singhs. (1)
lines: Then did all the Brars calling an assembly of their whole fraternity,
They decided upon a line of action (to deal with the Singhs).
Resolving to disguise themselves in the guise of Gilja Pathans,
They must launch an attack on the Khalsa Panth Singhs.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

Seeing Gilja Pathans, would the Singhs take to their heels, Then would the Brars grab the Singhs' total belongings. The same disguise then did the Brars put on, After resolving to cover their soldiers with red robes. (2)
lines: Seeing Gilja Pathans, would the Singhs take to their heels,
Then would the Brars grab the Singhs' total belongings.
The same disguise then did the Brars put on,
After resolving to cover their soldiers with red robes.

blocks.text: Pulling out the red coloured shawls from the heads of their females, The Brars covered their horses saddles with the red robes. Covering their own bodies with red coloured cotton wrappings, They hoisted red shawls on their lances as Pathan emblems. (3)
lines: Pulling out the red coloured shawls from the heads of their females,
The Brars covered their horses saddles with the red robes.
Covering their own bodies with red coloured cotton wrappings,
They hoisted red shawls on their lances as Pathan emblems.

blocks.text: Raising and unfurling these red coloured emblems atop their lances, The Singhs started beating drums as if these were drum-beats of war. The intelligence front-runners among the Singhs being always on the alert, They spotted out the red shirts' advancing movement. (4)
lines: Raising and unfurling these red coloured emblems atop their lances,
The Singhs started beating drums as if these were drum-beats of war.
The intelligence front-runners among the Singhs being always on the alert,
They spotted out the red shirts' advancing movement.

blocks.text: Running fast immediately as they alerted the Singhs, They took to their heels without caring for their belongings. As the Khalsa contingent retreated for so many miles, Then did the contingent chiefs chalked out a strategy. (5)
lines: Running fast immediately as they alerted the Singhs,
They took to their heels without caring for their belongings.
As the Khalsa contingent retreated for so many miles,
Then did the contingent chiefs chalked out a strategy.

blocks.text: Dohra:

Thereafter did the Khalsa Panth contingent chiefs remarked, That they must stop to take stock of the whole situation. As they had already reached the end of the Malwa region, How could the Kabul-based Pathans invade them at that end? (6)
lines: Thereafter did the Khalsa Panth contingent chiefs remarked,
That they must stop to take stock of the whole situation.
As they had already reached the end of the Malwa region,
How could the Kabul-based Pathans invade them at that end?

blocks.text: Chaupai If they (the Singhs) continued retreating and running further, Definitely would they die of thirst for want of water.
As the situation demanded that they must stand firm there, Let that happen what the Divine Will ordained for them. (7)
lines: As the situation demanded that they must stand firm there,
Let that happen what the Divine Will ordained for them.

blocks.text: Thereupon, did the Singhs give a beat on the war-drum, As did the standard-bearers raised the continental emblems. Then did the brave Singh warriors turn back, As did all the contingent chiefs assembled at the back. (8)
lines: Thereupon, did the Singhs give a beat on the war-drum,
As did the standard-bearers raised the continental emblems.
Then did the brave Singh warriors turn back,
As did all the contingent chiefs assembled at the back.

blocks.text: As Sardar Charat Singh had been at the rearguard, He turned back and entered into confrontation with the Brars. As he did see through the Brars in Pathan disguise, He called all the Singhs loudly to turn back immediately. (9)
lines: As Sardar Charat Singh had been at the rearguard,
He turned back and entered into confrontation with the Brars.
As he did see through the Brars in Pathan disguise,
He called all the Singhs loudly to turn back immediately.

blocks.text: Hearing this, the Singhs returned and attacked the Brars, Which the latter failed to repulse with all their might. So did the Brars desert with the Singhs in hot pursuit, Thus did the Singhs capture a few while the rest fled away. (10)
lines: Hearing this, the Singhs returned and attacked the Brars,
Which the latter failed to repulse with all their might.
So did the Brars desert with the Singhs in hot pursuit,
Thus did the Singhs capture a few while the rest fled away.

blocks.text: Dohra:

The Brar mothers whose sons had been made captives, Those mothers came running after their captive sons. Pleading their cases for mercy before the Singhs, These mothers got their sons released from the Singhs. (11)
lines: The Brar mothers whose sons had been made captives,
Those mothers came running after their captive sons.
Pleading their cases for mercy before the Singhs,
These mothers got their sons released from the Singhs.

blocks.text: Chaupai:

As hostility developed between the Singhs and the Brars, The Singhs did not spare the Brars at any cost. As the Brars started constructing concrete buildings, The Singhs started digging bunkers around their settlements. (12)
lines: As hostility developed between the Singhs and the Brars,
The Singhs did not spare the Brars at any cost.
As the Brars started constructing concrete buildings,
The Singhs started digging bunkers around their settlements.

blocks.text: As the water-table receded and dried up in the dug-up wells, The Brars would desert that spot for want of water. The Singhs would allow a safe passage to the Brars, But they would seize their buffaloes and horses of quality breed. (13)
lines: As the water-table receded and dried up in the dug-up wells,
The Brars would desert that spot for want of water.
The Singhs would allow a safe passage to the Brars,
But they would seize their buffaloes and horses of quality breed.

blocks.text: Thus did the Brars get defeated by the Khalsa Singhs, For their own misdeeds did the Brars face harassment. From someone would the Singhs charge a ransom, From another would they demand his daughter in wedding. (14)
lines: Thus did the Brars get defeated by the Khalsa Singhs,
For their own misdeeds did the Brars face harassment.
From someone would the Singhs charge a ransom,
From another would they demand his daughter in wedding.

blocks.text: Thus beating the Brars into submission as their subjects, The Singhs would stay put perforce in their homes. Then did the Brars become humble followers of the Singhs, Thus did the Khalsa Panth Singhs pass their time well. (15)
lines: Thus beating the Brars into submission as their subjects,
The Singhs would stay put perforce in their homes.
Then did the Brars become humble followers of the Singhs,
Thus did the Khalsa Panth Singhs pass their time well.

blocks.text: Dohra:

Then did the Singhs return to the same Malwa region, After teaching a good lesson to the wily Brars. Now would the same Brars come forth voluntarily, Begging the Singhs to be their guests at their homes. (16)
lines: Then did the Singhs return to the same Malwa region,
After teaching a good lesson to the wily Brars.
Now would the same Brars come forth voluntarily,
Begging the Singhs to be their guests at their homes.

blocks.text: The Brars who got themselves initiated into Khalsa Panth, Truly were they blessed by the Guru's grace. Rattan Singh (the author) as he heard from his father, He had narrated it as such the whole account. (17)
lines: The Brars who got themselves initiated into Khalsa Panth,
Truly were they blessed by the Guru's grace.
Rattan Singh (the author) as he heard from his father,
He had narrated it as such the whole account.
